newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.10 rupees up at 42.98 to the dollar on Tuesday in the kerb as players sold dollars to invest in stocks after the president sacked Benazir Bhutto's government, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to rise further on Wednesday as more investors switch out of the dollar to join what brokers said would be a bull-run at the Karachi bourse.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates closed at 7.20 percent, against its previous close at 7.40 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
